title: Standard rule v1
description: config/standard/rules/<id>.json (PADRAO-DEV F1b): one rule of the development standard, an STD object of the engineering model. It holds only what is declared: the statement, its basis, its owner, the object types it applies to, how it is checked and its state. What can be derived is not here: the tests of its check come from the covers manifests, and a refusing function or a gate stage with no rule is a warning of scripts/model check.

id.description: The rule id, equal to the file name.

statement.description: What the rule requires, in one or two sentences.

state.description: draft: written, not yet checked; warning: checked and reported, with a deadline; blocking: a violation stops the change; replaced: a newer rule took its place. dormant (D-326): its check runs only in tooling a decision stopped (dormant_by names it), so it counts in no enforcement measure and needs no basis while dormant.

owner.description: Who answers for the rule: a domain of AGENTS.md (capacity, efficiency, administration) or Daniel.

applies_to.description: The model object types the rule judges.

kind.description: function: a refusing function, ref `<file>:<function>`; gate-stage: a stage of the gate, ref its name; test: a test file, ref its path; judgment: no executable check, ref the document where the rule is written.

basis.description: The decisions that justify the rule.

deadline.description: For a rule in warning: the date by which it is promoted to blocking or retired.

dormant_by.description: For a dormant rule (D-326): the decision that stopped the tooling its check runs in.
